description: wind-up is a Python package for estimating the change in energy yield after an intervention at a wind farm. It compares operational turbine data before and after a change, using reference turbines and controls described in its documentation. Users supply SCADA power, wind and event records; outputs include estimated production uplift and uncertainty for the turbines under study. Geographic coverage is the wind farm provided by the analyst. The README links examples and package instructions, and GitHub metadata states BSD-3-Clause licensing. A limitation is that causal interpretation depends on a valid reference period and comparable wind conditions; concurrent maintenance or sensor changes can confound an estimated uplift. The package can improve generation assumptions in infrastructure planning models. The related catalogue ERA5 reanalysis supplies weather context but is not a turbine performance assessment. No SCADA records or package were downloaded.
name: wind-up turbine yield assessment
